headline: Chile's IPSA Gains 0.96% as Peso Strengthens Against US Dollar
summary: Chile's benchmark IPSA stock index gained 0.96% to 10,450 as the Chilean peso recovered from recent 12-month lows, easing to 1,016 per dollar following three sessions of depreciation.
why: Chilean financial asset movements reflect international copper price sentiment and foreign institutional capital flows.
